# braintrust_acl (Resource)

Manages a Braintrust ACL (access control list) entry. ACLs grant a permission or role to a user or group on a specific object.

ACLs are **immutable** — any attribute change requires destroying and recreating the ACL, so the permission is briefly revoked during the replacement. ACLs are inherited through the object hierarchy (e.g., a project ACL applies to all experiments and datasets within it).

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "braintrust_project" "my_project" {
  name = "my-project"
}

resource "braintrust_group" "ml_team" {
  name = "ML Team"
}

data "braintrust_role" "engineer" {
  name = "Engineer"
}

# Optional: resolve a user by email for direct user ACL grants.
data "braintrust_user" "alice" {
  email = "alice@example.com"
}

# Grant a group a role on a project
resource "braintrust_acl" "ml_team_project_access" {
  object_type = "project"
  object_id   = braintrust_project.my_project.id
  group_id    = braintrust_group.ml_team.id
  role_id     = data.braintrust_role.engineer.id
}

# Grant a specific permission to a group
resource "braintrust_acl" "ml_team_read_logs" {
  object_type          = "project"
  object_id            = braintrust_project.my_project.id
  group_id             = braintrust_group.ml_team.id
  permission           = "read"
  restrict_object_type = "project_log"
}

# Grant a permission directly to a specific user (resolved by email).
resource "braintrust_acl" "alice_project_read" {
  object_type = "project"
  object_id   = braintrust_project.my_project.id
  user_id     = data.braintrust_user.alice.id
  permission  = "read"
}
```

## Schema

### Required

- `object_id` (String) The ID of the object the ACL applies to.
- `object_type` (String) The type of object the ACL applies to. One of: `organization`, `project`, `experiment`, `dataset`, `prompt`, `prompt_session`, `group`, `role`, `org_member`, `project_log`, `org_project`, `org_audit_logs`, `project_group`, `project_group_projects`, `ai_secret`, `org_ai_secret`, `org_account`.

### Optional

- `group_id` (String) ID of the group the ACL applies to. Exactly one of `user_id` and `group_id` must be provided.
- `permission` (String) The permission the ACL grants. Exactly one of `permission` and `role_id` must be provided. One of: `create`, `read`, `update`, `delete`, `create_acls`, `read_acls`, `update_acls`, `delete_acls`.
- `restrict_object_type` (String) Optionally restricts the permission to a specific object type. Cannot be set when `role_id` is used. One of: `organization`, `project`, `experiment`, `dataset`, `prompt`, `prompt_session`, `group`, `role`, `org_member`, `project_log`, `org_project`, `org_audit_logs`, `project_group`, `project_group_projects`, `ai_secret`, `org_ai_secret`, `org_account`.
- `role_id` (String) ID of the role the ACL grants. Exactly one of `permission` and `role_id` must be provided.
- `user_id` (String) ID of the user the ACL applies to. Exactly one of `user_id` and `group_id` must be provided.

### Read-Only

- `created` (String) Date of ACL creation.
- `id` (String) Unique identifier for the ACL (UUID).
- `object_org_id` (String) The organization the ACL's referenced object belongs to.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import by the acl ID.
terraform import braintrust_acl.example 00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000
```
